preconditions.description: The total weight n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of children k must be between 1 and 100.
The minimum edge weight d must be between 1 and k.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str((count_paths(n, k, d) - count_paths(n, k, d-1)) % 1000000007)
postconditions.description: The output must be the number of valid paths modulo 1000000007.
